item.title: Swissvotes — via awesome-digital-history
item.description: Database of Swiss federal popular votes since 1848, including results, contextual information, analyses, original documents, and downloadable data.

item.title: Books as Data — via awesome-digital-history
item.description: Full-text and metadata corpus of 1700–1900 prints from four Swiss libraries, with bulk export and IIIF images.

item.title: SWISSTOVAL — via awesome-digital-history
item.description: Historical money-value calculator that converts Swiss sums and early modern coins from 1600 to 2025.

item.title: Euro-Climhist — via awesome-digital-history
item.description: Database of documentary weather and climate data for Europe, with a focus on Switzerland and free registration.

item.title: LUX: Yale Collections Discovery — via awesome-digital-history
item.description: Cross-collection discovery portal for exploring cultural and natural heritage materials held by Yale University’s museums, libraries, archives, and galleries.
